claim: research-informed adversarial coverage ledger; not compliance or certification

sources.theme: zero trust; no implicit trust from network location or ownership
secure software development and supply-chain risk reduction
artifact provenance, hosted builders, hardened builds
authorized functionaries, material/product rules, signed step links
signature attribution is not policy or goodness; transparency assumptions
rollback, freeze, fast-forward, and mix-and-match attacks
dependency and pipeline integrity, immutable references, least privilege
component identity, hashes, dependency relationships, known unknowns

bats.attack: treat co-location, service presence, or another role's identity as implicit authority
bats.result: source, Bardo, and destination identities are distinct; network/service location grants no authority

bats.attack: freshly sign semantically unlawful claims and extension-smuggled authority
bats.result: valid signatures remain attributable but policy-invalid statements are refused

bats.attack: reuse or mix signed links from separately lawful ceremonies
bats.result: crossing/receipt ancestry and pinned whole-evidence identity reject link reuse and mix-and-match

bats.attack: replace historical SB-001 with a different lawful ceremony or prior evidence set
bats.result: pinned evidence-set ID rejects historical substitution

bats.attack: treat unresolved WAIT as an update freeze that must expire
bats.result: not imported: unresolved duration is domain policy; forced freshness would collapse legitimate uncertainty

bats.attack: substitute source commit, repository, ref, path, blob, route, or role key
bats.result: source and evidence provenance are pinned, but no independent hosted-builder provenance attestation exists

bats.attack: mutable CI action tags, excessive token permissions, persisted checkout credentials, lifecycle-script execution
bats.result: actions pinned to commit SHAs; contents read-only; checkout credentials not persisted; package lifecycle scripts suppressed

bats.attack: dependency-resolution drift, registry substitution, or transitive dependency change
bats.result: direct dependency versions are exact, but no committed package-lock currently exists; reproducible dependency resolution is not proven

bats.attack: unknown or substituted software component hidden outside the declared inventory
bats.result: no machine-readable SBOM is currently committed; component completeness is not proven

bats.attack: all local historical material is rewritten before an external observer sees it
bats.result: no independent transparency log or external checkpoint witness exists yet

bats.attack: repository-control compromise changes verifier and evidence together
evidence: GitHub API: repository rulesets returned empty; branch-protection endpoint unavailable to integration
bats.result: repository policy is not treated as a proven root of trust

bats.attack: source, Bardo, and destination keys all collude before the ceremony
bats.result: outside SB-001's proof boundary; requires an external trust root, quorum, hardware-backed identity, or transparency witness
